prompt:
We're adding a new feature to our existing healthcare patient portal: online prescription refill requests. Patients will be able to:
- View their current prescriptions (pulled from our EHR system via HL7 FHIR API)
- Request a refill, which creates a task in the GP's queue
- Receive a notification (email or SMS) when the GP has approved or declined
- GPs can add a note to declined requests

We're UK-based, so GDPR applies. We also follow NHS Digital standards. The portal already handles authentication (NHS login integration) but this is a new module.

Initial requirements:
1. Patients can view active prescriptions
2. Patients can submit a refill request
3. GPs receive and can action refill requests
4. Patients receive notifications on request status changes
5. Integration with existing EHR via FHIR API
